999008199.text:
どうしたのさ……こんな夜更けの港に呼び出すなんて。
まさか告白とか、そういうセンもあったりする？

localizations.en: What's this about, calling me out to the harbor in the dead of night? Don't tell me this is a confession or something?

999008199.text:
ある意味ではそうかもしれんな。
ジョゼ・ダンブロシオ。お前の力を借りたい

localizations.en: In a sense, perhaps it is. José d'Ambrosio. I need your help.

999008199.text:
また監察官になれって話？
悪いけど、それだけは何度言われても無理だね

localizations.en: Not the 'become an inspector' speech again? Sorry, but I'll never agree to that no matter how many times you ask.

999008199.text:
いや、今回は少し違う。
賞金稼ぎとして協力してほしいんだ

localizations.en: No, this time it's different. I want you to cooperate as a bounty hunter.

999008199.text:
おっ。少しは俺の生き方に譲歩してくれたんだ。
それで、あんたらに協力して俺になんの得が？

localizations.en: Oh? So you're finally willing to compromise with my way of life. And what's in it for me if I help you folks?

999008199.text: もしかして、オイタしても見逃してくれるとか？

localizations.en: Maybe you'll turn a blind eye if I step out of line?

999008199.text: そんなわけがないだろう。オイタをしたら叱る

localizations.en: Of course not. If you step out of line, I'll set you straight.

999008199.text:
だよね。むしろそうでないと寂しいよ、
張り合いがなくて

localizations.en: Thought so. Honestly, I'd be disappointed if you didn't. Where's the fun otherwise?

999008199.text:
ついでに聞くけどさ、向こうに人を置いてるのは
俺が拒否したら無理矢理拘束するため？

localizations.en: By the way, those people you stationed over there—are they backup in case I refuse and you need to restrain me?

999008199.text:
いや、彼女たちもお前に言いたいことがあるそうだ。
モテるな、お前

localizations.en: No, they have something they want to say to you as well. You're quite popular, it seems.

999008199.text:
まぁ仮面で個性を出してるからね。結構モテるよ。
ただ――

localizations.en: Well, I do stand out with this mask. I get plenty of attention. But—

999008199.text: おっかなそうな連中にモテるのは、考えものだね

localizations.en: Being popular with scary folks like them? That's a mixed blessing.

999008199.text:
なんだ、旅の終わりに知った顔が出迎えか？
気が利くじゃないか。土産はないがな

localizations.en: What's this? Familiar faces to greet me at journey's end? How thoughtful. Though I'm afraid I didn't bring souvenirs.

999008199.text: ヘルト、ゼロ……！
駆け付けてくるとは感心だ。話が早くていい

localizations.en: Impressive that you came running. This saves time.

999008199.text:
うぬらの言う通り、世界を見て回ってきてやったぞ。
なかなか退屈しない旅じゃったわ

localizations.en: As you requested, we have traveled and observed the world. It was a journey free of boredom, I must say.

999008199.text: ……どうだった？　今の人間自身が管理する世界は

localizations.en: ...So? What did you think of the world managed by humans themselves?

999008199.text: 端的に言って、健気だな

それぞれが懸命に、その日を生きている。
その姿は美しくて、それでいて弱くて儚い

localizations.en: Each person lives their day earnestly and with determination. That sight is beautiful, yet fragile and fleeting.

999008199.text:
か弱い花はより上位の存在である我らが「管理」して
育ててやらねばならぬ！　そう思ったのじゃ

localizations.en: Such delicate flowers must be managed and nurtured by superior beings such as ourselves! That is what we concluded.

999008199.text:
やっぱりそういう結論になったのね。
なんでもベスティラにもちょっかいかけたそうじゃない

localizations.en: So that's where you landed. I heard you've already started meddling in Bestira.

999008199.text:
ああ、あそこは「管理」が必要な国の典型だ。
力不足の癖に、己の腕っぷしを頼みにしている

localizations.en: Ah, yes. That nation is a prime example of one requiring management. Despite their inadequacy, they rely solely on their own strength.

999008199.text:
ああいう連中には絶対的な上位存在を分からせんとな。
もう少し謙虚に生きてもらいたいもんだ

localizations.en: Such people need to understand there exists an absolute superior being. They should live with more humility.

999008199.text:
結局、さらなる力で統治するってことですか？
納得いきません！

localizations.en: So you're saying you'll just rule through overwhelming power? I can't accept that!

999008199.text:
人類の上位者を名乗る者の統治など
生憎と望んでいない

localizations.en: Humanity has no need for governance by those who claim superiority over us.

999008199.text:
やたら突っかかるじゃないか。
俺はむしろ「管理」してやると言っているのに

localizations.en: How confrontational. And here I'm offering to 'manage' you out of goodwill.

999008199.text:
俺たち上位存在の力が無用だと言うなら、
それ相応の力を見せてみることだ

localizations.en: If you claim our power as superior beings is unnecessary, then show us strength worthy of that claim.

999008199.text: あれは……「九偉人図」、それも２枚も！？

localizations.en: Those are... Portraits of the Nine—two of them?!

999008199.text:
お前たちはこれを探していたのだろう？
九偉人図……もう少し似せて描いてもらいたかったなぁ

localizations.en: You've been searching for these, haven't you? The Portraits of the Nine... I wish they'd made them look more accurate, honestly. They look nothing like us.

999008199.text:
旅先で見つけたついでに保護してやったのじゃ。
欲しければ、力ずくで奪ってみるがよい

localizations.en: We found them during our travels and took them for safekeeping. If you want them, try taking them by force.

999008199.text: 力が見たけりゃ見せてやるわよ！

localizations.en: You want to see our strength? We'll show you!

999008199.text:
その代わりこっちが勝ったらその九偉人図をもらうわ！
あと、キューンとか兄弟への接し方も改めて！

localizations.en: But if we win, we're taking those Portraits! And you're going to change how you treat Quinn and the others!

999008199.text:
注文が多い妹だな……だが、それくらい
わがままなほうが手が掛かってかわいいというもの

localizations.en: So many demands from my little sister... But I suppose that bratty willfulness makes you all the more endearing.

999008199.text:
そっちが世界旅行してる間にね、こっちだって
ただ待ってたわけじゃない。腕を上げたのよ！

localizations.en: While you two were on your world tour, we weren't just sitting around waiting. We've gotten stronger!

999008199.text: それでは見せてもらうか

localizations.en: Very well, let's see what you can do.

999008199.text: っ！
ヴァレリア！！

ふむ、本当に腕は上げたようだし、
俺への備えも十分といった様子だ

localizations.en: Hmm, you truly have improved, and your preparations against me seem adequate.

999008199.text:
我らと戦う最低限の資格はあるようじゃの。
久方ぶりに楽しめそうじゃ！

localizations.en: You possess the minimum qualifications to face us in battle. This should prove entertaining after so long!

999008199.text:
チッ……なんて迫力だ……
こいつら、まさかこのままここでやり合う気か……？

localizations.en: Damn... what presence... Don't tell me they're planning to fight right here, right now...?
